messages:
Rina: Heads-up  I started a compact PR to add a "Short-Sequence Migration Cheatsheet" to Optimize (prefetch knobs, quant profile recipes, and two canary templates). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024
Omar: Nice! One ask: the doc currently links to an internal prefetch helper repo. Can we paste a public-safe 30-line helper into /examples so external users can follow along?
Rina: Yep. I'll paste a distilled helper and add a note: "sanitized for public docs". Draft helper is in the PR as a fenced snippet.
Felix: A few technical points: 1) KV-prefetch can increase cold-start p95 for very short prompts; recommend disabling when median_seq_len < 50 or when route cold_start_rate > 15%. 2) q4 variants sometimes misalign tokens on models Zeta/Yukon for <24 tokens. Recommend q8_0 or fp16 fallback in that bucket.
Rina: Added a short rule-of-thumb table and a 1-line toggling example: 
```json
{"route": "/chat/short", "kv_prefetch": false}
```
June: Can we include two canary templates? One conservative and one standard. Ops likes concrete percentages and the metric wiring. Suggest: conservative: 5%->20%->50%->100% (monitor: latency_p95, exact_match_regression, token_cost_delta). Standard: 10%->40%->100% (same monitors).
Rina: Done. Added JSON blobs for both and a short wiring note about Console alerts. Example: 
```json
{"canary":"conservative","steps":["5%","20%","50%","100%"],"monitors":["latency_p95","exact_match_delta","token_cost"]}
```
Omar: Tiny SDK compat note: Batch client names changed across 0.9.x -> 0.10.0. Please add a compatibility footnote and small migration snippet for Go/Py/JS.
Rina: Added compatibility notes: mentions BatchClientV1 vs BatchClient and a minimal migration snippet in each language.
Felix: Testing guidance: explicitly say to validate with a representative prompt set (~2k samples) and compare p95/p99 and exact-match delta. Also provide a small script to synthesize the set.
Rina: Added synth_prompts.py example and a short bash command to run evals locally and in Console.
June: UX nit  collapse the migration checklist into steps with checkboxes so readers can tick off pre-checks, canary, and post-verify. Also add anchors for quick jumps.
Rina: Done  collapsible checklist + anchors included.
docs-bot: @Rina created JIRA-OPT-623 (docs: public prefetch helper + short-seq cheatsheet + canary templates) :bell:
Omar: One more: add a one-liner for release notes: "Docs: Optimize - short-sequence cheatsheet (prefetch, quant recipes, canary templates)" so PMs can include it.
Rina: Added to release notes draft. Thanks all :rocket: I'll keep the PR open for final comments; aiming to merge after Felix's quant pass tomorrow morning.
Felix: I'll review quant wording and sample numbers by 09:00 PT and leave inline comments.
Rina: Great  TY everyone.
